description: This file defines the 'RomChecksum' class, which provides static methods for calculating and validating checksums within ROM data arrays. It is part of the 'com.romraider.maps' package and interacts with external classes like 'Settings' and 'RomAttributeParser'.

classes.name: RomChecksum
classes.description: Provides static methods for computing and verifying checksums within ROM data arrays, ensuring data integrity during tuning and reflashing processes.

methods.name: calculateRomChecksum
methods.description: Calculates checksums for specified regions within the input byte array and updates the checksum values in the array.

methods.name: validateRomChecksum
methods.description: Validates the checksums of specified regions within the input byte array, returning an indicator of success or the position of failure.

methods.name: validateChecksum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum of a specific region within the input byte array and compares it with an expected total.

methods.name: calculateChecksum
methods.description: Computes the checksum bytes for a specific region within the input byte array.
